logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of Ru1–R4 was measured by using the ‘shakeflask’ ultraviolet spectrophotometry method.40–42 Octanol-saturated water (OSW) and water-saturated octanol (WSO) were prepared by mixing octanol and distilled water. They were prepared from the mixed solution of 25 mL of n-octanol and 25 mL of water shaken in a sealed flask at RT for 24 h. Ru1–R4n-octanol solutions were prepared using the above solvents. Aliquots of stock solutions of the ruthenium complexes in OSW were added to equal volumes of WSO and shaken for another 24 h at 60 rpm at RT. The concentration of Ru1–R4 in the n-octanol phase was determined by UV-vis spectroscopy. Partition coefficients of the ruthenium complexes were calculated using the equation: log Po/w = log ([Ru]OSW/[Ru]WSO).
